##Rates
**Private Charter: 1–6 People** 
*Captain Fee paid during time of booking*

**Bareboat Charter: 7-12 People** 
***Please note:** There is an additional Captain Fee due after the trip & must be paid directly to the Captain. 

**Bareboat Charter Info:** Following current Coast Guard regulations, your Bareboat Charter doesn't include a Captain. But don't worry, we have a list of skilled Licensed Captains familiar with our program and boats.
description:
#Wildly Fun and Unforgettable!

Picture this: you're about to book an epic experience for your best friend's special day on a luxury sailboat, soaking up the San Diego sun and sea. It doesn't get much better than that!

We've thrown epic bachelorette parties for countless guests, and we're here to make your life easy. Everything you need for a killer party is ready to roll when you arrive. Let the good times sail!
